title: Norml Security
actsOn: Protected credential stores and selected local files
pitch: Keep secret values outside model-visible text and handle storage, exposure and local scanning through explicit scope.
problem: Secrets can persist in command arguments, transcripts, config and backups even after a visible copy disappears.
This skill uses protected entry and local consumers, separates rotation from cleanup, and makes scanner coverage and limitations explicit.

flow.d: Verify provider, resource, existing store and allowed effects.
Use a masked native prompt or supported provider auth.
Confirm identity and intended read without showing secret values.
Rotate/revoke and reconcile actual consumers when required.
Report privately; redact only under reviewed opt-in scope.

items.role: Masked dialog plus native Keychain APIs

items: No Linux secret-store helper is shipped.
Windows helper needs an explicitly installed reviewed CredentialManager module and verification on Windows.
Scanner patterns do not cover every secret format, Git history, browser stores or cloud logs.
Private-key header findings are report-only; local deletion does not revoke credentials.
Original backups remain in separate private storage until cleanup is authorized; --report-dir selects reports only.
